layout.title: Grill and Homestyle Food in Zagreb
layout.description: Dvije Žarulje in Zagreb serves grill dishes, daily specials, fried classics, salads and sides for dine-in, takeaway and delivery.

hero.p1: A Zagreb spot for ćevapi, burgers, chicken grill, daily cooked dishes and quick lunches near a busy city route.

services.heading: Grill Menu
services.p: Ćevapi, burgers, chicken breast and mixed platters made for a proper lunch or dinner.

services.heading: Daily Specials
services.p: Cooked dishes such as wine goulash, stews and seasonal homestyle favorites.

services.heading: Takeaway & Delivery
services.p: Order for pickup or delivery through available platforms such as Wolt and Glovo.

about.title: Straightforward, satisfying food in Zagreb
about.p1: Dvije Žarulje is a Zagreb hospitality business focused on grill dishes, daily cooked meals and food that works well for a lunch break, takeaway or delivery.
about.p2: The menu brings together grilled meat, fried dishes, salads and sides, including ćevapi in flatbread, gourmet burgers, Zagreb-style schnitzel and wine goulash.
about.p3: Good food does not need to overcomplicate things: quality meat, familiar flavors and portions worth coming back for.

extra.title: From the grill to daily cooked dishes
extra.p1: The grill menu includes ćevapi, šiš ćevapi, burgers, chicken breast and sharing platters, served with flatbread, onion and classic sides.
extra.p2: For guests who want something homestyle, the daily menu brings stews, goulash, fish dishes and fried classics with sides.

portfolio.title: Familiar flavors, quick service and generous portions

items.quote: A good place for a quick, filling lunch, especially when you want grill without a long wait.
items.name: Restaurant guest

items.quote: The ćevapi and burgers are satisfying, and the side options make ordering simple.
items.name: Regular guest
